changeSet.author: Puneet Gupta
changeSet.rollback: CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [dbo].[CalculatePassedPropertyForAssetResult] ( @ResultUid uniqueidentifier ) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( select AR.Uid, case when AR.PassCount=0 AND AR.FailCount=0 then 0 when (CAST(AR.PassCount as float) / (AR.PassCount+AR.FailCount)) >= R.Threshold then 1 else 0 end as [Passed] from dbo.AssetResult AR, dbo.AssetResultEdge E, graph.AssetNode AN, [Rule] R, Asset A where AR.Uid = @ResultUid and MATCH(AN-(E)->AR) and E.Class = 1 and A.UID = AN.UID and R.id = A.ObjectID and A.[object] = 'Rule' )
